facts.fact: Projet TRANSFORME says 33 commercial-court procedure maps were validated on 15-17 July 2026 and that consultants will now draft the specification for a future digital platform managing commercial court proceedings from filing to judgment.
facts.system: digital platform for managing commercial proceedings

systems.system: digital platform for managing commercial proceedings

facts.fact: UNDP says SIGAJ, a system for managing judicial cases, was among four digital systems introduced in DRC's justice sector over 2020-2024.

Actualite.cd reports the Ministry of Justice launched on 5 November 2026, with UNDP support and EU funding, the interconnection of courts, prosecutors' offices and prisons on a common digital infrastructure for judicial and prison management applications, to be extended progressively.
facts.system: interconnection of courts, prosecutors' offices and prisons

facts.fact: FOLUCCO's director general said on 18 June 2026 it will launch a pilot digitising the Gombe Tribunal de paix and its prosecutor's office, with funding already available, under the Justice 2.0 programme whose projects include an integrated judicial case management system.
facts.system: Justice 2.0 integrated judicial case management system
